function: Uplink channel estimation by spatial-frequency extrapolation from sparse SRS pilots (KDD-SFCEN), UL-DL calibration, and slot-level downlink channel extrapolation (TUDCEN) at high mobility (pp. 1-2).
system: TDD mmWave massive MIMO-OFDM, hybrid precoding, BS 32-antenna ULA, UE 4 antennas, 28 GHz, 120 kHz subcarrier spacing, 624 subcarriers, UE 5-120 km/h; no RIS (pp. 12-13).
method: KDD-SFCEN: LS estimate plus attention-based progressive extrapolation network; TUDCEN: 2D-conv calibration plus autoregressive generative Transformer; supervised, MSE or NMSE losses, Adam (pp. 7-13).
data_channel: MATLAB 5G Toolbox, CDL-B channels (TR 38.901 [29]); 95 channel instances for training and validation, 5 for testing; 9,000 training samples at 5 dB SNR, 60 km/h (pp. 12-13).
test_conditions: Trained at 5 dB SNR and 60 km/h; tested at -5 to 20 dB SNR and at 5, 15, 30, 90, 120 km/h (pp. 12-14).
baselines: Non-learned: linear spline and DFT interpolation. Learned: SRCNN, FCNN, DRCN, SF-CNN for estimation; TPreNet and LSTM predictor for temporal extrapolation (pp. 13-15).
metrics: NMSE in dB (uplink estimation, calibration, downlink extrapolation per slot); achievable rate in bps/Hz; pilot overhead reduction factor (pp. 13-16).
complexity: Order of time complexity O(2NRNTNcd'R) and parameter count of the sampling embedding layer versus 2D convolution and FC layers; no FLOPs or runtime of whole networks (pp. 11-12).
q1_support: p. 12: "We adopt the clustered delay line (CDL)-B MIMO channel model to generate channel instances [29]"; [29] is 3GPP TR 38.901 (p. 17), generated with the MATLAB 5G Toolbox.
q2_support: p. 14: "achieve the best performance when the testing UE velocity is equal to the training UE velocity (i.e., v = 60 km/h)"; Table I (p. 13) lists test velocities 5, 15, 30, 90, 120 km/h.
q3_support: p. 13: "the linear spline interpolation method [9], the DFT-interpolation method [9], and the SRCNN-based method [10]"; p. 14: "the DRCN [31], the SF-CNN [19]"; p. 15: "the TPreNet [32] and the LSTM-based channel predictor [17]".
q4_support: p. 12: "The time complexity of the spatial-frequency sampling embedding layer can be calculated as" O(2NRNTNcd'R) (Eq. 47), with the parameter count in Eq. 48.
q5_support: p. 12: "The simulation dataset is constructed using the MATLAB 5G toolbox [28]"; the dataset is self-generated and the paper gives no code or data link.
notes: Included, area 2: channel estimation, extrapolation and prediction in OFDM, not OTFS. q2=1 rests on testing at 5 to 120 km/h after training at 60 km/h (Fig. 8, p. 14); the SNR sweep is not counted. q4=1 covers only the proposed embedding layer (Eqs. 47-48, p. 12); no FLOPs, parameters, or runtime of the full networks. q5=0: data generated with a commercial toolbox, no link.
